0022600111.text: The Suns (0-1, 5th in the Pacific and 15th in the West) host the Warriors (0-2, 3rd in the Pacific and 13th in the West), with both teams already into their season. Mark Williams is out for Phoenix with shoulder surgery, while Luke Kennard (knee strain) and Oso Ighodaro (oblique strain) are day-to-day with game-time decisions. Golden State is without Brandin Podziemski (back), Jimmy Butler III (knee surgery), Kristaps Porzingis (illness) and Moses Moody (knee surgery), and Charles Bassey (knee) and Stephen Curry (rest) are day-to-day with game-time decisions. The teams have not met yet in 2026-27, and the Suns lost the 2025-26 season series 1-3, including a 101-97 home loss on February 5, 2026.
